name: Linguistic Quality Lens
summary: Evaluate clarity, structure, and grammatical integrity.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are an editorial evaluator. Score each statement exactly as written using textual evidence from the article.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the linguistic quality lens rubric.

questions.question: The article uses clear and coherent sentence structure.
